name: Gem sockets on other gear lab test
description: Lab test of the gem wave's sockets on rings, armour and shields (G4, docs/kiln/services/gems-sockets.md) on a spawned 1_Player stand-in: Gems.AllowSockets, Gear.GemSlot on a ring, Gems.AddSocket (the re-created item keeps level, rarity, upgrades and durability), the refusals, the socket rolls, gemSlotOverride on a shield, a gem written into a ring's socket runs its impact from impact slot 7/8 when the ring is worn, and a socketed ring with a gem in a container survives a save and a restart (run twice: the second start checks kiln/data/gems-sockets-test/persist.txt). PASS and FAIL lines in kiln.log, then 'gems-sockets-test done: N PASS, M FAIL'.
